text:
sarah: Quick sync — we're greenlighting GA for the marketplace listing next week. Need final alignment on driver/CUDA/ROCm pins we advertise, partner hotfix-window, and canary plan. Can people confirm compatible stacks and whether we need a pinned fallback? cc @alex @mike_ops :eyes:

alex: I'll run the compatibility matrix today. Preliminary notes: runtime validated with CUDA 12.2 + NVIDIA driver 535.* and ROCm 5.5 on our onprem images. Saw a perf regression on A100 with driver 536.x in an internal benchmark — investigating.

alex: Quick canary command and env we used for the smoke:
```
kubectl -n canary apply -f canary-deployment.yaml --record
# env used for smoke
MODEL=redwood-lite
CUDA=12.2
DRIVER=535.86
ROCM=5.5
```
Estimate ~2h to run the full pass (including embedding and chat flows).

mike_ops: Ops can open a hotfix window 2026-04-01 22:00-02:00 UTC. We'll have 2 engineers + oncall. If partner requests a driver rollback, we can orchestrate but need partner signoff by EOD today to schedule.

sarah: Partner comcoms/legal asked for a short "validated with pinned drivers" blurb on the marketplace tile. I propose this wording to avoid over-commitment:
- "Validated with NVIDIA driver 535.x (CUDA 12.2) and ROCm 5.5 — fallback to pinned variants available if regressions are detected."
Thoughts?

anna_devex: Docs/devex: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and a known-issues callout. Suggest we include a short HCL snippet and an explicit A100 note. Proposed customer-facing note:
- If you see a perf drop on A100, pin to NVIDIA driver 535.86 or use Dedicated capacity.
I can have a PR up within 3h.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: canary/redwood-lite at 4032123600 UTC. Notifying eng-oncall.

alex: Kicked off tests. Early logs show a rare kernel timeout on one A100 instance — correlates with driver 536.x. Opening ticket ENG-DRIVER-1347 labeled "driver-regression". Plan in ticket: (1) continue canary; (2) if failure rate >1%, rollback to 535.86 and mark canary as failed; (3) notify partner and hold hotfix window.

sarah: :thumbsup: Plan: (1) Alex to post final compatibility matrix and attach logs by 4032123700; (2) Mike to hold the hotfix window and standby for rollback; (3) Anna to publish marketplace copy and a short rollback playbook for customers. I'll update partner that GA will ship with pinned wording and a documented rollback path.

mike_ops: Ack. I'll be on call for the window. @sarah I need the partner contact for signoff and SSO keys if we need to trigger partner-side rollback.

sarah: Partner contact is Lina (I emailed her at 11:03). I'll do a quick follow-up and drop the contact into the ticket.

sarah: small ask for release notes: Alex, can you paste the concise compatibility summary we should put in the marketplace tile (one line)?

alex: "Compatible: CUDA 12.2 (NVIDIA driver 535.x); ROCm 5.5. Known issue: regression observed on driver 536.x for A100 — fallback to 535.86 available."

sarah: Perfect. I'll use that. Thanks everyone — I'll post an update to the partner channel once Alex confirms the final matrix. :rocket:
